create_gemma3n_config: create a Gemma3nConfig dataclass instance with custom model_dim and num_layers for the Gemma3n model
create_gemma3n_audio_config: create a Gemma3nAudioConfig dataclass instance to configure the USM Conformer audio encoder tower
get_gemma3n_e2b_config: get the Gemma3n E2B preset configuration with 30 layers and 8192 FFN inner dimension
get_gemma3n_e4b_config: get the Gemma3n E4B preset configuration with 35 layers and 15 KV shared layers
is_global_layer: check if a given layer index uses global attention or local sliding window attention
